public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun
public_declarations.header: def slowSelectRun (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : Measured (Option α) Nat

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_value
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_value (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).1 = (ordered xs)[k]?

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_cost
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_cost (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).2 =
      (InsertionSort.sortRun (· ≤ ·) xs).2 + min k xs.length + 1

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_cost_of_lt
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_cost_of_lt (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).2 = (InsertionSort.sortRun (· ≤ ·) xs).2 + k + 1

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_some_iff
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_some_iff (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (a : α) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).1 = some a ↔ RankedAt xs k a

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_none
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_none (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).1 = none ↔ xs.length ≤ k

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_public
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_public (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).1 = sortSelect (k + 1) xs

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_cost_bound
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_cost_bound (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).2 ≤ xs.length ^ 2 + 3 * xs.length + 1

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_cost_of_pairwise
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_cost_of_pairwise (k : Nat) (xs : List α)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hs : xs.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).2 = 2 * xs.length + k + 2

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_cost_reverse_range
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_cost_reverse_range (n k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    (slowSelectRun k (List.range n).reverse).2 =
      (n + 1) * (n + 2) / 2 + k + 1

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_entry_bound
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_entry_bound (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    1 + (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun xs).2 + (slowSelectRun k xs).2 ≤
      xs.length ^ 2 + 4 * xs.length + 3

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowSelectRun_cutoff_bound
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowSelectRun_cutoff_bound (k : Nat) (xs : List α)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hn : xs.length ≤ 20) :
    1 + (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun xs).2 + (slowSelectRun k xs).2 ≤ 483

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowMedianRun
public_declarations.header: def slowMedianRun (xs : List α) : Measured (Option α) Nat

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowMedianRun_value
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowMedianRun_value (xs : List α) :
    (slowMedianRun xs).1 = lowerMedianWith List.head? xs

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowMedianRun_cost
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowMedianRun_cost (xs : List α) :
    (slowMedianRun xs).2 = (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun xs).2 +
      (slowSelectRun ((xs.length - 1) / 2) xs).2

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowMedianRun_some_iff
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowMedianRun_some_iff (xs : List α) (a : α) :
    (slowMedianRun xs).1 = some a ↔ RankedAt xs ((xs.length - 1) / 2) a

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowMedianRun_none
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowMedianRun_none (xs : List α) :
    (slowMedianRun xs).1 = none ↔ xs = []

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowMedianRun_mem
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowMedianRun_mem (xs : List α) (a : α)
    (ha : (slowMedianRun xs).1 = some a) : a ∈ xs

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowMedianRun_cost_bound
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowMedianRun_cost_bound (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    (slowMedianRun xs).2 ≤ xs.length ^ 2 + 4 * xs.length + 2

public_declarations.name: Resources.SelectionAuxiliary.slowMedianRun_small_bound
public_declarations.header:
theorem slowMedianRun_small_bound (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ [])
    (hn : xs.length ≤ 5) : (slowMedianRun xs).2 ≤ 47

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.empty_payload_selection
public_declarations.header: theorem empty_payload_selection : slowSelectRun 17 ([] : List (Fin 0)) = (none, 2)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.singleton_selection
public_declarations.header: theorem singleton_selection : slowSelectRun 0 [7] = (some 7, 4)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.singleton_invalid
public_declarations.header:
theorem singleton_invalid : slowSelectRun 1 [7] = (none, 5) ∧
    slowSelectRun 17 [7] = (none, 5)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.public_rank_bridge
public_declarations.header:
theorem public_rank_bridge {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).1 = sortSelect (k + 1) xs

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.duplicate_occurrence_rank
public_declarations.header: theorem duplicate_occurrence_rank : RankedAt [3, 1, 3, 2] 2 3

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.collapsed_occurrence_rank
public_declarations.header: theorem collapsed_occurrence_rank : RankedAt [0, 0, 0, 0] 2 0

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.valid_selection_budget
public_declarations.header:
theorem valid_selection_budget {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (xs : List α) (k : Nat) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    (slowSelectRun k xs).2 ≤ xs.length ^ 2 + 3 * xs.length + 1

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.empty_payload_median
public_declarations.header: theorem empty_payload_median : slowMedianRun ([] : List (Fin 0)) = (none, 3)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.singleton_median
public_declarations.header: theorem singleton_median : slowMedianRun [7] = (some 7, 6)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.lower_even_median
public_declarations.header: theorem lower_even_median : slowMedianRun [7, 2] = (some 2, 10)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.repeated_central_values
public_declarations.header: theorem repeated_central_values : slowMedianRun [4, 4] = (some 4, 9)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.ascending_five_median
public_declarations.header: theorem ascending_five_median : slowMedianRun (List.range 5) = (some 2, 20)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.descending_five_median
public_declarations.header: theorem descending_five_median : slowMedianRun (List.range 5).reverse = (some 2, 30)

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.same_median_different_work
public_declarations.header:
theorem same_median_different_work :
    (slowMedianRun (List.range 5)).1 = (slowMedianRun (List.range 5).reverse).1 ∧
      (slowMedianRun (List.range 5)).2 < (slowMedianRun (List.range 5).reverse).2

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.arbitrary_short_chunk
public_declarations.header:
theorem arbitrary_short_chunk {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) (hn : xs.length ≤ 5) :
    (slowMedianRun xs).2 ≤ 47

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.singleton_short_chunk
public_declarations.header: theorem singleton_short_chunk : (slowMedianRun [9]).2 ≤ 47

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.median_value_and_budget
public_declarations.header:
theorem median_value_and_budget {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (xs : List α) (a : α) (ha : (slowMedianRun xs).1 = some a) :
    RankedAt xs ((xs.length - 1) / 2) a ∧ a ∈ xs ∧
      (slowMedianRun xs).2 ≤ xs.length ^ 2 + 4 * xs.length + 2

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.cutoff_sorted_last
public_declarations.header:
theorem cutoff_sorted_last :
    1 + (Resources.SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (List.range 20)).2 +
      (slowSelectRun 19 (List.range 20)).2 = 83

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.cutoff_descending_last
public_declarations.header:
theorem cutoff_descending_last :
    1 + (Resources.SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (List.range 20).reverse).2 +
      (slowSelectRun 19 (List.range 20).reverse).2 = 273

public_declarations.name: Examples.SelectionAuxiliary.cutoff_uniform_budget
public_declarations.header:
theorem cutoff_uniform_budget {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (xs : List α) (k : Nat) (hk : k < xs.length) (hn : xs.length ≤ 20) :
    1 + (Resources.SymmetricCosts.lengthRun xs).2 + (slowSelectRun k xs).2 ≤ 483
